posts.text:
Breaking news: A three-story building collapse in Brooklyn has killed eight people and injured at least 17, including three firefighters, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said.

The casualties include children, according to New York City officials.

뉴욕시 관계자에 따르면 사상자 중에는 어린이도 포함됐다.
